method: Use stored native object poses and saved target poses, without simulator reruns. For swap_T target quaternion is q_ref * Rx(-90deg), invert with Rx(+90deg) following official load_actors, then apply official angle<15deg and xy<0.025,z<0.77. For rearrange use componentwise XY<0.03 and official stage/count.
